name: Cefic

summary.text: Cefic, the European Chemical Industry Council, is the Brussels-based trade association of the chemical industry in Europe, founded in 1972. It describes its membership as about 670 members and affiliates, including national chemical federations, corporate members and sector groups, representing roughly 29,000 chemical companies. It is registered in the EU Transparency Register (ID 64879142323-90) and, according to LobbyFacts, declared lobbying costs of 10 million euros or more for 2023 with 93 lobbyists and 166 high-level Commission meetings. In 2009 the European Commission suspended Cefic from the register for eight weeks after Friends of the Earth Europe complained that its declared lobbying budget of under 50,000 euros was understated.

facts.claim: Cefic describes itself as the forum of the chemical industry in Europe, representing about 29,000 chemical companies through 670 members and affiliates that include national federations, corporate members and sector associations.

sources.title: The forum of the chemical industry in Europe

facts.claim: Cefic was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Brussels; it engages with EU institutions on regulation such as REACH and CLP, climate and energy, and innovation, coordinates the Responsible Care programme in Europe and is a member of the International Council of Chemical Associations.

sources.title: The forum of the chemical industry in Europe

facts.claim: LobbyFacts records Cefic's EU Transparency Register entry (ID 64879142323-90, first registered in September 2009) as declaring lobbying costs of 10 million euros or more for the 2023 financial year, with 93 declared lobbyists (about 43 full-time equivalents), 14 European Parliament access passes and 166 high-level Commission meetings.
Cefic's register entry states that its registration covers all of its sector groups' activities aimed at influencing EU policy.

In July 2009 the European Commission suspended Cefic from the EU lobby register for eight weeks after a complaint by Friends of the Earth Europe that Cefic had declared a lobbying budget under 50,000 euros against an organisational budget of about 37.9 million euros; the Commission found the declared expenditure 'appears to be underestimated' and asked Cefic to correct it.

facts.claim: When Cefic re-entered the register later in 2009 it declared a lobbying budget of 4 million euros for that year; Corporate Europe Observatory said this was a small share of its total budget, with the remainder attributed to sector groups and research.
